how_to_use: Every row is a PROPOSAL. Nothing here is implemented except where status says IMPLEMENTED (this session's own deliverables). A reviewer chooses a decision path (A/B/C) per row BEFORE anything is built. 'Reversible' means a wrong choice can be undone without losing data; 'One-way door' means choose carefully.

verdict_key.IMPLEMENTED: Already built in nfl-arena/ and visible on this site this session

rows.problem: Eleven overlapping NFL namespaces duplicate facts and drift apart (A-05, A-06, A-07).
rows.proposal: Declare one canonical NFL facts namespace and demote the rest to archives linked from it.

decision_paths.label: Do nothing
decision_paths.consequence: Drift continues; reviewers must read 11 sites.

decision_paths.label: Declare nfl-lines canonical for numbers, nfl-arena canonical for decision layer, others archive
decision_paths.consequence: Cheap, reversible, additive; needs a nav note.

decision_paths.label: Physically merge all NFL content into one namespace
decision_paths.consequence: Cleanest end state but one-way door for old links; needs a link-redirect map.

rows.problem: COORDINATION.md is titled 'NBA Line Origination Research' though it now records mostly NFL work (A-08).
rows.proposal: Retitle to 'Own4 — Multi-Project Research Task Board' and add a one-line scope note per project.

decision_paths.label: Leave as is
decision_paths.consequence: New sessions keep misreading scope.

decision_paths.label: Retitle + scope note
decision_paths.consequence: Cosmetic, reversible.

decision_paths.label: Split into per-project boards
decision_paths.consequence: More structure, more files to keep in sync.

rows.problem: Depth-string verification covers 8 of 32 teams (A-11); the other 24 have blank string columns.
rows.proposal: Capture all 32 ESPN depth charts every Friday and join them to the official report automatically.

decision_paths.label: Keep 8-team manual capture
decision_paths.consequence: Tracker stays partial; blanks persist.

decision_paths.label: 32-team weekly capture, scripted
decision_paths.consequence: Full coverage; ~32 source pages per week; still third-party strings (A-12).

decision_paths.label: 32-team capture + snap-count cross-check from game books
decision_paths.consequence: Strongest evidence that listed strings match actual usage; highest effort.

rows.recommended_path: B (C later, when snap counts are available)

rows.problem: Captures miss Friday game-status designations and Saturday inactives (A-05, Q-11).
rows.proposal: Schedule two automated refreshes per week: Friday after the designation release, and Saturday/Sunday after inactives.

decision_paths.label: Ad-hoc manual capture
decision_paths.consequence: Stale designations keep appearing.

decision_paths.label: Two scheduled refreshes, timestamped
decision_paths.consequence: Designations current at decision time; cheap.

decision_paths.label: Refresh + alerting when a starter flips to Out
decision_paths.consequence: Fastest signal; needs a delivery channel.

rows.problem: The same game carries different market numbers in different files, with no capture timestamps (A-06).
rows.proposal: Standardise market data on one archive with a per-row captured_utc stamp and a documented sign convention.

decision_paths.label: Leave both
decision_paths.consequence: Gaps keep appearing between namespaces.

decision_paths.label: nfldata = source of record + dictionary + timestamps
decision_paths.consequence: One number per market; reversible.

decision_paths.label: Two-source reconciliation (archive vs broker feed) with variance flags
decision_paths.consequence: Best quality; needs second licensed source.

rows.problem: Week 10 gaps are measured against in-progress market numbers (A-09).
rows.proposal: Re-settle every week only against closing lines, after the final game of the week.

decision_paths.label: Evaluate on live numbers
decision_paths.consequence: Edges appear and vanish with the market.

decision_paths.label: Closing-line-only settlement
decision_paths.consequence: Standard, defensible; results lag by days.

decision_paths.label: Both, labelled (open vs close) with CLV column
decision_paths.consequence: More insight, slightly more work.

rows.problem: No verifiable player-prop prices or game logs exist in any source (A-13, Q-04); prop strategies are stuck at the gate.
rows.proposal: Connect a licensed prop-odds source plus an official player-stat feed before registering prop-combo strategies.

decision_paths.label: Drop the prop family
decision_paths.consequence: Scope shrinks to sides/totals; no blank columns left.

decision_paths.label: Licensed feeds when budget allows
decision_paths.consequence: Unlocks prop combos and player-level correlation (Q-09).

decision_paths.label: Synthetic prop prices for research only
decision_paths.consequence: Fast but risks unverifiable numbers; must never be labelled verified.

rows.problem: Both models are blind to confirmed QB changes and depth losses (Q-07, peer IR-11).
rows.proposal: Add a pre-registered QB/depth availability feature and measure it by walk-forward ablation before trusting any gap it creates.

decision_paths.label: Keep team-level only
decision_paths.consequence: Model keeps missing the biggest weekly information shocks.

decision_paths.label: Feature + ablation gate
decision_paths.consequence: Evidence-based decision on inclusion.

decision_paths.label: Full player-level market (EPA-based) rebuild
decision_paths.consequence: Best long-term model; large effort.

rows.recommended_path: B (C as a follow-on research track)

rows.problem: ROI-ranked lists reward variance unless luck is deflated explicitly (Q-03).
rows.proposal: Add a deflated-Sharpe / multiple-testing layer to every ranked list alongside the existing Wilson + BH-FDR columns.

decision_paths.label: Keep current columns
decision_paths.consequence: Acceptable for n<300; weaker for large strategy pools.

decision_paths.label: Add deflated-Sharpe column
decision_paths.consequence: One more computed column; reversible.

decision_paths.label: Bayesian skill posterior per strategy
decision_paths.consequence: Richest; needs priors decided up front.

rows.problem: Same-game leg dependence and player-prop dependence are unmeasured (Q-09).
rows.proposal: Estimate same-game dependence from settled game data first (team totals vs spread, total vs moneyline), then extend to props when player data exists.

decision_paths.label: Price parlays as independent legs
decision_paths.consequence: Systematic mispricing of correlated combos.

decision_paths.label: Game-level dependence now, props later
decision_paths.consequence: Improves parlay pricing with data we already have.

decision_paths.label: Wait for player data, do it once
decision_paths.consequence: No partial improvement.

rows.problem: Weather for future games is unverifiable ahead of time (peer IR-06); wind is used structurally in one strategy.
rows.proposal: Capture forecasts only on game-day mornings with retrieval timestamps and source links; never store earlier guesses.

decision_paths.label: Ignore weather
decision_paths.consequence: Wind/roof strategies can't be graded properly.

decision_paths.label: Game-day-morning capture, stamped
decision_paths.consequence: Verifiable; short lead time.

decision_paths.label: Multi-day forecast archive
decision_paths.consequence: More data, more unverifiable early values.

rows.problem: Improvement ideas previously lived inside individual namespaces, so nobody reviewed them as a queue.
rows.proposal: Keep this Suggestions page as the standing review queue: proposals, decision paths, and a reviewer verdict column that a future integration session implements.

decision_paths.label: One-off review, then archive
decision_paths.consequence: Queue goes stale.

decision_paths.label: Standing queue with verdicts recorded here
decision_paths.consequence: Traceable decisions; small upkeep.

decision_paths.label: Queue + issue-tracker mirror
decision_paths.consequence: Better notifications; two places to maintain.

rows.status: IMPLEMENTED (this page exists; verdicts still awaited)
